extra.message: Use of File.createTempFile with explicit workspace parameter may lead to insecure temporary file creation. The patched version uses createTempFileInSystemDir or createTempFile methods that enforce proper permissions (rw-------) on Unix-like systems. Replace with custom createTempFile method that ensures secure temporary file creation with restricted permissions.

metadata.remediation: Replace File.createTempFile($PREFIX, $SUFFIX, $WORKSPACE) calls with custom createTempFile method that ensures secure temporary file creation with proper permissions on Unix-like systems.
